lozenge.definition: n. a small aromatic or medicated candy
lozenge.translation:
n. 菱形, 菱形花纹, 菱形窗玻璃
[化] 锭剂

lozenges.definition:
n. a small aromatic or medicated candy
n. a dose of medicine in the form of a small pellet
lozenges.translation: n. [数] 菱形, 菱形花纹；菱形窗玻璃（lozenge的复数形式）

lozengy.definition:
a. Divided into lozenge-shaped compartments, as the field or
   a bearing, by lines drawn in the direction of the bend sinister.

lozzu.translation: 一种地中海马耳他渔艇
